title: Hardcoded accuracies written into a results CSV
description: The result dict written to cl_rehearsal_results.csv mixes live transfer metrics with hardcoded accuracy literals (T1_after_T1=97.50, T2_after_T2=72.26, T3_after_T3=76.89, T1_after_T2=95.81, T1_after_T3=95.65, T2_after_T3=73.14) and derives every forgetting field from those literals. This manufactures the exact artifact RULE 1 designates as the source of truth; downstream tools would ingest fabricated accuracies as measured. The checkpoint it claims to evaluate (final_dvs_dvs.pt) does not exist.
evidence: lines 106-107 accuracy literals; 108-112 forgetting arithmetic on them; verdict UNSOURCED
fix: Delete the hardcoded accuracy/forgetting fields; write only columns computed live this run, or gate the whole CSV write behind a real evaluation.

title: Hardcoded per-task accuracies and forgetting arrays drive Figures 1-2
description: acc_t1=[97.30,97.37], acc_t2=[80.26,81.98], acc_t3=[84.85,84.47], forget_noreplay/forget_replay are literal arrays plotted as this experiment's results. This is the pre-2026-07-14 generator that generate_figures_3seed.py documents as fabricated and replaced, but it was never removed and still writes PNGs.
fix: Delete the file (superseded by generate_figures_3seed.py); at minimum delete these literals and read from a CSV.

title: Legacy bi-modal numbers mislabelled as 'single-task' reference lines
description: axhline(y=97.68,'N-MNIST single-task') and axhline(y=82.16,'SHD single-task') overlay two constants on a tri-modal plot. Cross-referencing m7_mps.py:2286-2287 confirms these are legacy bi-modal Paper-2 M3/M2 results, not single-task baselines of this experiment. The label asserts a different experiment's numbers as this one's.
fix: Delete both lines (already removed in the 3seed version); if single-task baselines are wanted, run them into the CSV.

description: The comment on line 39 reads 'simulated from log data'; gate_noreplay_shd/gate_replay_shd are hardcoded hop/hgrn weight sequences plotted as Figure 3 - the paper's central gate-specialisation claim. A fabricated trajectory presented as the measured gate behaviour.
evidence: lines 39-48 and Figure 3 block 122-151; verdict UNSOURCED (fabricated)

title: 3 of 4 columns in the printed COMPARISON TABLE are hardcoded literals

Printed under a bare 'COMPARISON TABLE' header with no disclaimer, the table reads as four measured conditions when three are baked in.

title: Hardcoded replay-memory bars and compression factors

title: Hardcoded Paper-2 M1-M5 reference block under a 'FINAL NUMBERS FOR PAPER' header
description: Printed literals for N-MNIST/SHD M1-M5 plus 'Best N-MNIST 97.68%', 'Best SHD 82.16%', 'Cross-modal gap 21.53pp'. Disclosed as 'Paper 2 reference' so not mislabelled as M7, but hardcoded with no CSV, and one block sits under a 'FINAL NUMBERS FOR PAPER - NeurIPS 2026' header (3839). Near-identical copies in m7_raw.py and m7_trimodal_cl.py.
evidence: m7_mps.py:2284-2288 and 3845-3846; copies m7_raw.py:2261-2264,3822-3823; m7_trimodal_cl.py:2211-2214; verdict UNSOURCED

title: Hardcoded 'Independent M7' reference lines 97.70 / 82.21
description: axhline(97.70,'Independent M7') and axhline(82.21,'Independent M7') draw single-task M7 baselines as hardcoded literals (82.21 matches the two-task onboarding-brief SHD number). No CSV backs them. Copies in m7_raw.py:3704 and m7_trimodal_cl.py:3654.

title: Energy-efficiency claim rests on an assumed 5% spike rate
description: estimate_synops_analytical hardcodes SPIKE_RATE=0.05 ('estimated from Paper 2') and computes snn/ann energy and an efficiency_x fold-factor written to energy_results.json. The spike rate that must accompany accuracy has to be measured from the trained model, not assumed; the result is an analytical estimate on an unmeasured input and is not a hardware energy result. Copies in m7_raw.py:3290 and m7_trimodal_cl.py:3240.
evidence: const at m7_mps.py:3313; cell 3305-3434; verdict UNSOURCED
fix: Measure spike rate from a real forward pass into a CSV and drive the estimate from that; label output 'analytical estimate, not hardware-measured'.

title: SynOps energy uses Hopfield 256 patterns, but M7 config is 100
description: The shared-component term 512*256*SPIKE_RATE uses 256 patterns. M7's call site sets num_patterns=100; 256 is the class default / legacy bi-modal value. The energy estimate counts a component the actual M7 model does not have. Copies m7_raw.py:3323, m7_trimodal_cl.py:3273.
fix: Replace 256 with the config value (read CONFIG['num_patterns']=100); do not hardcode.

title: '95% CI' is actually mean +/- 1.96*std (missing /sqrt(n))
description: The printed interval is [mean-1.96*std, mean+1.96*std] labelled '95% CI'. A 95% CI of the mean is mean +/- 1.96*std/sqrt(n); what is computed is a ~95% normal spread of individual seeds, ~sqrt(n) wider. The label contradicts the statistic. The script also cannot currently run (loads a nonexistent checkpoint at line 207), so this is a latent mislabel, not a produced number.
fix: Either add /np.sqrt(len(SEEDS)) and keep the '95% CI' label, or rename the output to 'mean +/- 1.96 sigma (spread)'.

title: replay_weight written as 1.0 while the run is configured no-replay
description: The CSV row sets replay_weight=1.0 under condition='C_rehearsal', but the reconstructed config at lines 31-34 has use_replay=False and replay_weight=0.3. The provenance column contradicts the config it claims to reproduce.
fix: Write cfg.replay_weight (and cfg.use_replay) rather than a literal, or correct the condition label.

title: Non-standard 5-seed set (disclosed, distinct purpose)
description: SEEDS=[42,123,456,789,999] differs from the project policy [42,123,456]. It is disclosed in the docstring as '5 random seeds for Poisson input encoding' variability, a legitimate distinct purpose, so not a violation - but easily conflated with the CL seed set.
fix: No code change required; ensure any reported number states '5 Poisson-input seeds', never '5 CL seeds'.

title: Figure 4 memory derived from CONFIG and explicitly labelled (compliant pattern)
description: The compliant counter-example to RA-006. SAMPLES_PER_CLASS/FEATURE_DIM/BYTES/CLASSES/FRAME_ELEMS are config constants, the arithmetic is printed for audit (304-310), and the figure title reads '(derived from CONFIG, not measured)'. It asserts a footprint from configuration, not a measurement, and says so.
evidence: lines 281-328, title at 323; verdict DISCLOSED (correct pattern)
fix: No fix. Keep as the reference pattern for how to present a config-derived quantity.
